log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (none) to 5 (trace). Higher levels help debug issues.

log_targets.description: Where to send logs. Choose from 'syslog', 'file', or both.

polling_rate.description: Default polling rate in Hz. Set to 0 to use the device's native rate.

report_rate.description: Default report rate in Hz (for devices supporting report rate control). Set to 0 for device default.

enable_profile_switch.description: Automatically switch to the last active profile when connecting a device.

supports_dpi.description: Enable DPI (dots per inch) resolution switching via D-Bus.

supports_buttons.description: Enable button remapping and macro assignment via D-Bus.

supports_macros.description: Enable macro playback via D-Bus. Requires device support.

device_quirks.description: List of per-device workarounds for hardware-specific issues.

device_id.description: Vendor:Product ID in hex (e.g., '1532:005b') or udev match pattern.

value.description: Quirk value — typically a comma-separated list of flags like 'disable-led', 'legacy-report', etc.

description.description: Brief human-readable explanation of the quirk’s purpose.
